Options:
opa. Mastocytoma, observation as it probably involutes.
opb. Sebaceous nevus, extirpation.
opc. Angiofibroma, exploration of the whole body surface and genetic study.
opd. Congenital melanocytic nevus, monitoring and photographic control.
